speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The final assessment of Arcadia’s wind energy project is complete.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The combined mitigation strategy, blade visibility enhancement and seasonal turbine shutdowns, has proven highly effective.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Bird mortality has dropped to minimal levels during migration seasons.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: The red knot population shows clear signs of recovery along its traditional routes.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia is now fully compliant with its obligations under the Ramsar and Bonn Conventions.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: This combination represents best-practice precautionary governance for wind energy near protected wetlands

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: Although seasonal shutdowns reduce total energy output during migration periods, national renewable targets remain achievable.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD REPRESENTATIVE
text: The visual impact of painted turbines remains noticeable, but economic effects are limited and manageable

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Arcadia’s approach is now being cited as an international model for balancing SDG 15 with SDGs 7 and 13.
